facts.fact: The Gambia Revenue Authority and Senegalese Customs agreed to install the GAINDE customs system at Karang, Keur Ayib and Selety border posts within three months.

GMB.note: Data exchange by API is only agreed for after GAINDE is operational.

SEN.note: Article only plans GAINDE installation at Gambian posts and future API exchange; no stated in-service Senegal declaration processing.
